2585-3698-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-3698-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Grim Monolith, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

250-779-1479-5412-7885.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-7885.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5412-7885.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.
